excerpts.quote: Your dog is welcome to join you in the Visitor Centre, along all trails and on the shuttle to the tip.

dogRules.text: Dogs are welcome in the Visitor Centre, on all trails and on the shuttle to the tip.
There is no off-leash area in the park.
Only oTENTik sites 8 and 9 at Camp Henry are pet-friendly; at most 2 pets, no pets on beds.
Never leave a pet in a vehicle alone.
